integrity: The exact 81-by-81 characteristic polynomial identity is recomputed from integer traces with Newton identities; separate direct enumeration checks small cases. No non-computational claim of independent review.
scientific_limitations: Two-row cyclic prisms with n>=3; exact optimum partition counts only; no analogous claim for other cylinders or k-limited partitions. The finite matrix identity is an exact, reproducible computation. Full text of the 2016 perfect-colorings paper was not available for inspection; independent validation and exhaustive publication priority remain outstanding.
title: Exact optimal 2-limited packing partitions of cyclic prisms
